correctness.rationale: Explicit 27-line-class adjacency yields unique SRG (27,16,10,8), whose nontrivial eigenvalues 4 and -2 give an exact spectral lower bound on induced edges. Fourteen written subsets achieve its integer rounding at each size up to 13; complements cover the other sizes. The magnetic ground-state envelope follows algebraically from B(k), and all counts are finite exhaustive exact-integer results checked by two distinct 2^27-state algorithms, sector visitation totals and direct edge computations.

evidence: Dutour Sikirić, Madore, Moustrou and Vallentin, doi:10.1112/jlms.12456, Sections 5.2.4 and 6.2 use the graph to obtain a chromatic Hoffman bound 9 and nine-colourings.
Brouwer graph entry gives the 45 independent triples and 40+160 nine-colour partitions as structural facts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A lower eigenvalue -2 yields the general inequality e(T)>=k(k-3)/3 but does not alone prove integrality-sharp witnesses for each of the 14 distinct subset sizes, or enumerate all optimizer counts. The chromatic and colouring theorems solve different optimization problems and do not yield the requested magnetic-sector degeneracies.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The cut law is equivalent to a minimum induced-edge profile e_min(k)=ceil(k(k-3)/3) for 0<=k<=13 and its complementary counterpart. A zero-temperature bivariate Ising-polynomial Newton envelope is another equivalent expression. The inspected finite-geometry sources identify these objects but do not specify this profile and all of its optimizer multiplicities.

originality.rationale: No examined exact statement or stronger implication contains both the rounded-sharp maximum-cut profile for every cardinality of the 27-vertex Schläfli graph and its complete ground-state field staircase with optimizer multiplicities. The graph itself, the eigenvalue bound, independent-triple counts and the general Ising spectral-polynomial framework are known and credited. The all-cardinality sharpness witnesses and new sector enumeration were separately compared; novelty remains provisional because specialized older tables might exist.
residual_risks: Historical edge-isoperimetric or bivariate Ising enumerator tables for the 27-vertex Schläfli graph may be unindexed or not retrieved; independently establishing global historical priority would require a broader archival review.
Known small-subset orbit results, especially the 45 independent triples, are not novel parts of the statement.
No independent external audit of the computation or priority has been performed.

value.rationale: A natural exceptional 27-site E6 geometry is found to saturate its rounded spectral isoperimetric bound for every spin sector, which is a structural property beyond a lone maximum cut or known colour class. Its full Ising magnetization envelope has exact four equally spaced field thresholds, unusual large coexistence degeneracies and a reproducible finite benchmark for frustrated spin networks. The precise complete classification is mathematically motivated, not an arbitrary subset slice.
